subject: gk
question: According to Census 2011, what is the estimated percentage of people below the poverty line in rural areas?
solution:
The correct answer is **__25.70%.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The definition of the poverty line include a combination of **calorie intake and income/expenditure**.
 
• The **Tendulkar Committee (2009) **recommended for estimating the poverty line based on **consumption expenditure.**
 
• The **National Sample Survey Office (NSSO) **conducts surveys.
 
• These figures help in the allocation of schemes like **MGNREGA, PDS, **and other direct cash transfer schemes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Census of 2011, which was the **15th in this series and the 7th after independence.**
 
• The sex ratio was found to be **940 females for every 1000 males**.
 
• Major religious groups included **Hindus (79.8%), Muslims (14.2%), Christians (2.3%), Sikhs (1.7%), Buddhists (0.7%), and others**.
 
• Scheduled Castes comprised about 16.6% of the population, while Scheduled Tribes made up about 8.6%.
